title: Research in space yields clues to treating muscle loss back on Earth
summary_en: Iowa State researcher Khaled Kamal is mapping how microgravity conditions during spaceflight accelerate musculoskeletal decline in the human body, work that could influence NASA’s long‑duration missions and help develop emerging therapies for muscular dystrophy, age-related sarcopenia, immobilization due to injury or long hospital stays, and even health conditions related to sedentary lifestyles h
